desc.en: Build automation flows to connect several apps together in your app's backend. For example, send a Slack message or add a Google Sheet row when an event fires in your app. Free up to 5,000 tasks per month.
desc.zh: 构建自动化流程，在应用后端将多个应用连接在一起。例如，当应用中触发事件时发送 Slack 消息或向 Google Sheet 添加一行。每月最多免费 5,000 个任务。

desc.en: Back4App is an easy-to-use, flexible and scalable backend based on Parse Platform.
desc.zh: Back4App 是一个基于 Parse Platform 的易用、灵活且可扩展的后端。

desc.en: Mobile and Web Baas, with 1 GB file storage free, push notifications of 50,000/month, and 1000 data objects in the table.
desc.zh: 移动和 Web BaaS，免费提供 1 GB 文件存储、每月 50,000 条推送通知和表中 1000 个数据对象。

desc.en: Unlimited chat messages, p2p voice & video calls, files attachments and push notifications. Free for apps up to 1000 users.
desc.zh: 不限数量的聊天消息、p2p 语音和视频通话、文件附件和推送通知。用户不超过 1000 人的应用免费。

desc.en: Reactive backend as a service, hosting your data (documents with relationships & serializable ACID transactions), serverless functions, and WebSockets to stream updates to various clients. Free for small projects - up to 1M records, 5M monthly function calls.
desc.zh: 响应式后端即服务，托管你的数据（带关联关系的文档和可序列化的 ACID 事务）、无服务器函数，以及向各类客户端流式推送更新的 WebSocket。小型项目免费——最多 100 万条记录、每月 500 万次函数调用。

desc.en: Define, version, and deploy automation scripts using YAML. A developer-first alternative to drag-and-drop tools. Can be used for scheduled tasks, AI agents, and infrastructure monitoring. Free tier includes 100 credits/month.
desc.zh: 使用 YAML 定义、版本化和部署自动化脚本。开发者优先的拖拽工具替代方案。可用于定时任务、AI 智能体和基础设施监控。免费套餐包含每月 100 额度。

desc.en: Build your Flutter App UI without writing a single line of code. Also has a Firebase integration. The free plan includes full access to UI Builder and Free templates.
desc.zh: 无需编写一行代码即可构建 Flutter 应用 UI。还提供 Firebase 集成。免费套餐包含对 UI Builder 和免费模板的完整访问。

desc.en: Build scalable In-App Chat, Messaging, Video and audio, and Feeds in a few hours instead of weeks
desc.zh: 只需数小时而非数周即可构建可扩展的应用内聊天、消息、视频和音频以及信息流

desc.en: Automate your favorite apps and devices. Free 2 Applets
desc.zh: 自动化你喜爱的应用和设备。免费提供 2 个 Applet

desc.en: Automate tedious tasks with a single click. Free 100 Tasks, 15 Minute
desc.zh: 一键自动化繁琐任务。免费提供 100 个任务、15 分钟

desc.en: Mobile backend. 1GB of data storage, 256MB instance, 3K API requests/day, and 10K pushes/day are free. (API is very similar to Parse Platform)
desc.zh: 移动后端。免费提供 1GB 数据存储、256MB 实例、每天 3K 次 API 请求和每天 10K 次推送。（API 与 Parse Platform 非常相似）

desc.en: Serverless backend for web and mobile apps. The free plan includes PostgreSQL, GraphQL (Hasura), Authentication, Storage, and Serverless Functions.
desc.zh: 面向 Web 和移动应用的无服务器后端。免费套餐包含 PostgreSQL、GraphQL（Hasura）、身份验证、存储和无服务器函数。

desc.en: Unlimited free push notifications. 10,000 email sends per month, with unlimited contacts and access to Auto Warm Up.
desc.zh: 不限数量的免费推送通知。每月 10,000 封邮件发送，联系人数量不限，并可使用 Auto Warm Up。

desc.en: Backend service API with flexible authentication, full-text search and caching. Free for one app, 1GB of app data.
desc.zh: 后端服务 API，提供灵活的身份验证、全文搜索和缓存。1 个应用、1GB 应用数据免费。

desc.en: Free push notifications for up to 1 million messages/month and 100 active daily devices
desc.zh: 免费推送通知，每月最多 100 万条消息和 100 台日活设备

desc.en: Free, unlimited push notifications for 2000 monthly active users. A single API for iOS and Android devices.
desc.zh: 面向 2000 名月活用户的免费、不限数量推送通知。适用于 iOS 和 Android 设备的单一 API。

desc.en: Move data everywhere instantly and automatically, multi-platform, unlimited sending and storage of structured data, max. 2,500 users/month
desc.zh: 即时自动地在各处移动数据，跨平台，结构化数据的发送和存储数量不限，每月最多 2,500 名用户

desc.en: AI no-code platform that turns a plain-language description into a complete business system with a relational database, dashboards, workflows, REST API and webhooks. Free plan for solo operators includes 2 apps, 1,000 records and 10 AI requests/day.
desc.zh: AI 无代码平台，可将纯语言描述转换为完整的业务系统，包含关系型数据库、仪表板、工作流、REST API 和 webhook。面向个人运营者的免费套餐包含 2 个应用、1,000 条记录和每天 10 次 AI 请求。

desc.en: The Open Source Firebase Alternative to build backends. Free Plan offers Authentication, Realtime Database & Object Storage.
desc.zh: 用于构建后端的开源 Firebase 替代品。免费套餐提供身份验证、实时数据库和对象存储。

desc.en: API management with authentication, quotas, monitoring and analytics. Free cloud offering
desc.zh: 提供身份验证、配额、监控和分析的 API 管理。免费云产品

desc.en: Connect the apps you use to automate tasks. Five zaps every 15 minutes and 100 tasks/month
desc.zh: 连接你使用的应用以自动化任务。每 15 分钟运行 5 个 zap，每月 100 个任务
